adjudication.rationale: The new unauthenticated `GET /embed/best` endpoint enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` whenever `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` returns nil, with no rate-limit/dedup before enqueue and no cap on `params[:embed_url]` size (EmbedController#best). Although `TopicRetriever` applies a 60s throttle per `embed_url` and checks for existing `TopicEmbed` (so there is some dedup/throttle at execution time), those protections happen *inside the job* and do not prevent an attacker from flooding Sidekiq/Redis with large numbers of queued jobs (and large `embed_url` payloads) by sending repeated requests with a forged `Referer` matching `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (ensure_embeddable only compares `URI(request.referer).host`). The 30s reload loop in `loading.html.erb` can also amplify repeated requests when an embed isn't yet available.
